prof_desc_male\u0004The last thing you r: The last thing you remember was meeting God behind the local Foodplace.  Then people started eating each other.  This doesn't feel like a fever dream.
prof_desc_male\u0004You've practiced par: You've practiced parkour for many years, and made the world your playground.  It wouldn't be a lie to say that running is your life.  Which is good, because now that the end has come, you're running for your life.
prof_desc_male\u0004You have received so: You have received some martial arts training at a local dojo.  You start with your choice of Karate, Judo, Aikido, Tai Chi, Taekwondo, or Pankration.
prof_desc_male\u0004You have studied the: You have studied the arts of the Shaolin monks.  You start with one of the five animal fighting styles: Tiger, Crane, Leopard, Snake, or Dragon.
prof_desc_male\u0004You are skilled in m: You are skilled in maneuvering on skates.  You suffer lower penalties to dodging and are less likely to fall down if hit in melee combat while you're wearing rollerskates or rollerblades.
prof_desc_male\u0004Circumstance left yo: Circumstance left you wandering the world, alone.  Now there is nothing to go back to, even if you wanted to.  Perhaps your experience in fending for yourself will prove useful in this new world.
prof_desc_male\u0004Some would say that: Some would say that there's nothing particularly notable about you, but you've survived, and that's more than most could say right now.
prof_desc_male\u0004At the start of the: At the start of the Cataclysm, you hunkered down in a bomb shelter with your collection of guns.  You've spent the past months eating canned food and practicing your aim.  Now it is winter - time to face the world above.
prof_desc_male\u0004Tailoring may not se: Tailoring may not seem like the most useful skill when the world has ended.  Most people wouldn't expect a simple tailor to live very long.  This is your opportunity to prove them wrong.
prof_desc_male\u0004Bork bork! Years in: Bork bork!  Years in the kitchen have left you carrying a prodigious bulk, but you managed to escape the carnage with your trusty butcher knife and only a small collection of stains on your uniform.
prof_desc_male\u0004What the deuyl? Ye: What the deuyl?  Ye ne wist noo thing of this straunge plaas nor what wycked enchauntment brought ye hidder.  Wyth this accoustrement ye must needs underfongen to find newe lyflode in the most hidous Cataclysm man hath witnessed sithen that deluge Noe rood out in his greet schippe.
prof_desc_male\u0004Thanks to years of s: Thanks to years of study and hard work in the lab, you're familiar with the basics of scientific inquiry.  Only one question remains: can you undo the very Cataclysm your colleagues helped create?
prof_desc_male\u0004Your flexible outloo: Your flexible outlook on the law, the scuffles you've been in (and avoided) at the bar, and your impressive ability to weasel your way out of the consequences of your actions - all these skills have helped ensure your survival.  How much longer will they hold out?
prof_desc_male\u0004You used to be a pro: You used to be a professional apiarist, building and maintaining beehives.  You had to abandon your precious bees when the Cataclysm struck, but at least you managed to grab some utensils and honey.
prof_desc_male\u0004You are the true Foo: You are the true Foodperson.  Some might think Foodperson is just a mascot, but you know better.  The mask has become your face, you are real, and the only thing standing between this world and oblivion is you.
prof_desc_male\u0004Joining the military: Joining the military has been your dream for years.  You finally got in, just in time for your training to get interrupted by some sort of national emergency.  As far as you can tell, military command abandoned you in this hellhole when you missed the emergency evac.
prof_desc_male\u0004You were the best of: You were the best of the best, the military's finest.  That's why you're still alive, even after all your comrades fell to the undead.  As far as you can tell, military command abandoned you in this hellhole when you missed the emergency evac.
prof_desc_male\u0004You were hired to ta: You were hired to take care of the housekeeping for a wealthy family.  Naturally, when things got bad, they all took off on a family vacation to somewhere unknown, leaving you to your fate.
prof_desc_male\u0004You were following a: You were following a road at night, trying to get away from the horrors of the city, when you heard a voice calling out in the dark.  You followed, hoping they were friendly, but suddenly felt a searing pain in your head and blacked out.  You just woke up in this strange place… are you even on Earth anymore?
prof_desc_male\u0004You were ready. You: You were ready.  You went in determined to find and rescue your friends.  Now the atmosphere in these twisting corridors grows heavy, and you don't feel quite so confident anymore.  You might be the one in need of a rescue soon.
prof_desc_male\u0004Fresh out of med sch: Fresh out of med school, you've got little in the way of practical experience and just a handful of first-aid supplies.  You just hope it will be enough if 'physician, heal thyself' turns out to be more literal than you expected.
prof_desc_male\u0004The boss always said: The boss always said he could rely on you to pull through on the tough jobs.  Shame he got himself smoked.  No problem; the world's always got a place for someone with your kind of talents.
prof_desc_male\u0004You had a boring, un: You had a boring, underpaid job watching cameras and patrolling hallways, but things have suddenly gotten a lot more dangerous.  You have some useful equipment, but you've never had any call to use it until now.
prof_desc_male\u0004You used to mow lawn: You used to mow lawns and trim hedges for the wealthy.  Contract work was getting scarce even before the zombies came, but now you've got nothing left except your tools and expertise.
prof_desc_male\u0004You went on providin: You went on providing in-home care for the elderly even as the whole world fell apart around you.  You can only pray that you don't see your former clients among the walking dead…
prof_desc_male\u0004Living off the land,: Living off the land, far from civilization, is nothing new to you.  The only difference is all the monsters that suddenly want you dead.  Your equipment is basic, but versatile… except that your canteen's run out!
prof_desc_male\u0004You spent your caree: You spent your career busting drug smugglers with your faithful canine companion.  Now the world has ended, and none of that matters anymore.  Your loyal dog is still at your side, though, ready to face the Cataclysm with you.
prof_desc_male\u0004Everyone is dead? O: Everyone is dead?  Oh well, it doesn't matter; it's not like you got along with people much anyway.  Your beloved cats are all the friends you need!
prof_desc_male\u0004Just a small-town de: Just a small-town deputy, you got the call and were ready to come to the rescue.  Soon it was you who needed rescuing, and you were lucky to escape with your life.  Who's going to respect your authority when the government this badge represents might not even exist anymore?
prof_desc_male\u0004You were on the brin: You were on the brink of a major breakthrough in your latest homicide case when the Cataclysm struck.  Now your prime suspect is dead.  Everyone's dead.  You could really use a smoke.
prof_desc_male\u0004As a member of the p: As a member of the police force's most elite division, you are more than adequately trained and equipped to survive the brutal onslaught of the apocalypse.  Unfortunately, the chain of command has broken down; your only mission now is to stay alive.

As a member of the police force's most elite division, you were given special training and became an expert in close-quarters combat.  Unfortunately, the chain of command has broken down; your only mission now is to stay alive.
prof_desc_male\u0004They said you'd sell: They said you'd sell your own mother for a dollar.  How dare they!  You've been around the block a few times, and you'd charge way more than a dollar - and get it, too!
prof_desc_male\u0004Ever since you were: Ever since you were a child you loved hunting, and quickly developed a talent for archery.  Why, if the world ended, there's nothing you'd want at your side more than your trusty bow.  So, when it did, you made sure to bring it along.

Ever since you were a child you loved hunting, and one year you got a shotgun for your birthday.  Why, if the world ended, there's nothing you'd want at your side more than your trusty shotgun.  So, when it did, you made sure to bring it along.

Ever since you were a child you loved hunting, and you fancy yourself a crack shot.  Why, if the world ended, there's nothing you'd want at your side more than your trusty rifle.  So, when it did, you made sure to bring it along.
prof_desc_male\u0004You used to work at: You used to work at a local hardware store, and you did plenty of home renovations yourself.  Now you look out at the horizon of a ruined world, and wonder - are your meager skills, and the few supplies you grabbed on the way out, sufficient to help rebuild?
prof_desc_male\u0004You once ruled the r: You once ruled the road in your big rig.  When the riots hit, you hopped in and drove it to safety.  Now it's just you and your truck against the world.
prof_desc_male\u0004Small businesses oft: Small businesses often hired you for electrical work.  You were halfway through your latest job when the whole power grid went dead.
prof_desc_male\u0004For the past few yea: For the past few years you've been traveling the world, sightseeing and living off your parents' trust fund.  You came home to find the world in ruins, and the only thing between you and death is the open road and your backpack.
prof_desc_male\u0004You just stepped out: You just stepped out of a nice, hot shower to find the world had ended.  You've got some soap, along with the most massively useful thing ever… a towel.
prof_desc_male\u0004Things got a little: Things got a little weird on your way to your weekly dance class.  Zombies don't seem to know how to dance, but you're not about to let them step on your toes.
prof_desc_male\u0004When the diagnosis c: When the diagnosis came back positive, you made a vow: to fight for your life, and to never give in to despair.  Now is the time to renew that vow.
prof_desc_male\u0004You were a human gui: You were a human guinea pig, used by laboratory technicians to understand the immense power of mutation.  You are determined to live on, if only to spite them for what they did to you.
prof_desc_male\u0004Your house has been: Your house has been demolished and your planet destroyed, but at least you still have your towel.
prof_desc_male\u0004You spent most of yo: You spent most of your life trapping with your father.  Both of you made a decent living selling your catches and running trapping tutorials.  Hopefully, your skills will come in useful against less conventional game.
prof_desc_male\u0004You ran into trouble: You ran into trouble coming out of class at your community college's metalsmithing program, but despite the havoc you've managed to keep ahold of some of the equipment you were carrying.
prof_desc_male\u0004All you ever wanted: All you ever wanted was to make people laugh.  Dropping out of school and performing at kids' parties was a dream come true until the world ended.  There are precious few balloon animals in your future now.
prof_desc_male\u0004In the rush to safet: In the rush to safety, you were separated from your master by cruel fate.  Now you are on your own, with nothing to your name but a suit of really kinky black leather.  Unfortunately, there are no safewords in the apocalypse.
prof_desc_male\u0004You haven't seen thi: You haven't seen this much blood since the war.  The whole world's gone crazy!  They ate your grandkids!  But dagnabbit, you'll make them all pay for what they've done.
prof_desc_male\u0004The Cataclysm struck: The Cataclysm struck on the big day and you escaped with nothing but your wedding attire.  Cold feet?  You'd just like to keep your feet attached!
prof_desc_male\u0004All those wicked son: All those wicked songs about the apocalypse have come to life.  Brutal!  Now that the system is dead, it's time to party among the bones of the world!
prof_desc_male\u0004Your ska band broke: Your ska band broke up after the drummer became a zombie.  Now you're alone in the Cataclysm with some cigarettes and your mp3 player.
prof_desc_male\u0004You were a serial ki: You were a serial killer, ready to walk the green mile, but in a twist of fate you're one of the few still alive.  True death comes only from your hands, so you're in for a job.
prof_desc_male\u0004You had a genius pla: You had a genius plan to skim fractions of cents out of your company's accounts.  This plan immediately failed and got you arrested.  They said you were too soft for prison, but guess what?  They're dead, and you're not.
prof_desc_male\u0004You did your best to: You did your best to expose what was going on in those labs, but they caught you and threw you in prison on trumped-up charges to silence you.  Clearly, they should have listened.
prof_desc_male\u0004You probably needed: You probably needed psychiatric help instead of a prison sentence.  At least your loyal subjects have agreed to hold the line as you make your daring escape.
prof_desc_male\u0004This could be your l: This could be your lucky break.  Plenty of loot to be pilfered, and no cops to be seen.  Does it count as breaking and entering if everyone in town is undead?
prof_desc_male\u0004The jury were in the: The jury were in the palm of your hand, but after the defendant tried to eat your brain, you were forced to flee the courtroom in disgrace.  Now nobody seems to care about your objections.
prof_desc_male\u0004You were one of the: You were one of the maintainers of a Shinto shrine, performing rituals and sacred tasks.  You preferred it when only the spirits of the dead inhabited your shrine, and not their rotting corpses.
prof_desc_male\u0004Your life was simple: Your life was simple at the Vihara, doing household chores and meditating.  Your Sangha wanted to attain liberation from suffering, now their rotting corpses will suffer forever.
prof_desc_male\u0004You spent much of yo: You spent much of your time prior to the apocalypse at the local mosque, studying the words of the Prophet and the Quran and guiding your community in prayer.  Back then they came from far and wide to listen to you; now they come to eat your brains.
prof_desc_male\u0004You devoted your lif: You devoted your life to spreading the good word, always on the road, traveling from town to town.  Now everything has gone to hell, you can't host your daily podcast, and the undead don't seem particularly moved by your sermons.
prof_desc_male\u0004You've decided today: You've decided today is the day to take your first lesson at the local dojo.  You'll be great at it, you're sure of it.
prof_desc_male\u0004'Drop the martial ar: 'Drop the martial arts!', they said.  'Learn a skill for the REAL world!', they said.  Well, you're about to show them!  SHOW THEM ALL!
prof_desc_male\u0004As the world ends, y: As the world ends, you alone stand against the coming darkness with your fists of steel.
prof_desc_male\u0004Following a clue fro: Following a clue from your dead grandfather's journal, you made your way to a long-lost temple, but then the ground started to shake uncontrollably.  You had a bad feeling about that, so you got out of there quickly.
prof_desc_male\u0004You set out this mor: You set out this morning to deliver the news of the apocalypse.  The undead hordes don't seem to value the latest news, but at least your trusty bicycle is still in working order.
prof_desc_male\u0004A patch of soil, som: A patch of soil, some water, and sunlight were all you ever needed; why should things be any different now?  With a handful of seeds and your trusty hoe, it's time to rebuild the Earth, one plant at a time.
prof_desc_male\u0004One of the lucky few: One of the lucky few who escaped the Cataclysm, you made a life for yourself amidst the ruins of civilization.  Whether through force, guile, or luck, you've obtained the best gear you could find.
prof_desc_male\u0004Over long years of s: Over long years of self-imposed exile in the wilderness, you have come to an understanding with Mother Nature.  The world as they knew it might have ended for your forsaken species, but you can hardly tell the difference.
prof_desc_male\u0004You spent most of yo: You spent most of your days fishing in the swamp, getting by quietly on your catch.  You found the buzzing of insects enjoyable, but recently they've gotten bigger and meaner.  Now their horrible noises have you spooked - you just hope the fish aren't as nasty.
prof_desc_male\u0004You were on your way: You were on your way to the Annual All New England Revolutionary War Living History exhibition when the end of the world permanently derailed your plans.
You were on your way to the Annual All New England Revolutionary War Living History exhibition when the end of the world made traditional gender roles obsolete.
prof_desc_male\u0004You love to skate!: You love to skate!  You've probably spent more time on a pair of blades than off.  Things have gotten pretty bad, but at least the grown-ups aren't telling you where you can't roll.
prof_desc_male\u0004You never cared for: You never cared for grown-ups telling you what to do, so you ended up spending quite a few days in the principal's office.  Now, not needing grown-ups to tell you what to do is the only reason you're alive.  Man, you really should've played hooky today.
prof_desc_male\u0004Your parents were cr: Your parents were crazy preppers who thought some "Cataclysm" was coming, and insisted on preparing you for it.  Turns out they were right.  You didn't get a chance to thank them.  The only thing you can do for them now is what they always hoped you would do in the dark days ahead: survive.
prof_desc_male\u0004In dodgeball, failin: In dodgeball, failing to dodge meant taking a ball to the head and being out of the game.  In the Cataclysm, it means getting eaten by monsters.  Don't slip up.
prof_desc_male\u0004The school never let: The school never let your club play with the really fun chemicals, the kind that make things go boom, but there aren't any teachers around to enforce the rules anymore.
prof_desc_male\u0004You were a member of: You were a member of the school A/V club.  You're sure there's some way you can use your technical skills to help you stay alive.  You just haven't figured out how to make an awesome death ray yet.
prof_desc_male\u0004You've been teaching: You've been teaching kids all your life, experiencing the joy and aggravation of imparting knowledge to young minds.  If zombies have any interest in education, they're not showing it.
prof_desc_male\u0004Covering the apocaly: Covering the apocalypse up close could make your career, though finding a publisher seems more difficult a prospect than usual.  You managed to hold onto your camera - hopefully you can get some fantastic shots.
prof_desc_male\u0004It was hard enough g: It was hard enough getting kids to run laps without having to worry about them trying to eat your brains.  Zombies won't even line up when you blow your whistle.
prof_desc_male\u0004You're a miner, not: You're a miner, not a minor!  Your canteen is dry, your jackhammer is out of gas, and you're on your last pair of batteries for your mining helmet…
prof_desc_male\u0004Before this all bega: Before this all began, you were having the time of your life at your dream job: blowing stuff up.  The Cataclysm means you're finally allowed to do it full time.
prof_desc_male\u0004You were called in o: You were called in on your day off to feed the animals at the zoo.  For some reason, none of your coworkers bothered showing up for work today.
prof_desc_male\u0004Years of training pr: Years of training prepared you for the competitive fencing circuit, but your latest tournament was cut short when zombies invaded the piste.  The referee was eaten, so you're not sure if the rules are still in play.
prof_desc_male\u0004You've spent your li: You've spent your life appealing to the people, persuading many and promising much throughout your time in office.  Now that your voting base wants to eat you alive, winning hearts and minds just got that much harder.
prof_desc_male\u0004Taking care of cows,: Taking care of cows, horses, and other animals is your passion, but the ways things are going, this isn't going to be just another day at the ranch.
prof_desc_male\u0004You've always worked: You've always worked just outside of the limelight, carrying and fixing the equipment and ensuring that the performers got what they needed.  The show must go on.
prof_desc_male\u0004You nailed your solo: You nailed your solo, but the audience erupted into screams instead of applause.  You weren't able to grab much during the panic, but at least you have your loaded six string on your back.
prof_desc_male\u0004You made your living: You made your living on Wild West exhibitions and shows, impressing tourists with your displays of marksmanship.  But that world has ended, so you took your trusty six-shooter and wandered into a world where it's always high noon.
prof_desc_male\u0004You were living the: You were living the high life, spending your parents' money without a care in the world.  At one of your usual crazy parties, the guests became hungry for more than drugs and booze, but you still have a chance to use the last symbol of your luxurious life - your sports car - and get far away.
prof_desc_male\u0004You got to see thing: You got to see things fall apart from the sky, transporting soldiers and survivors from one holdout to the next.  You knew it was only a matter of time before the horrors patrolling the skies shot you down.
prof_desc_male\u0004You were responding: You were responding to a call with your partner before you got separated.  Now all you have is your trusty ambulance, ready to transport patients through the apocalypse.
prof_desc_male\u0004You were separated f: You were separated from your partner while out on a call.  You managed to hang onto some medical supplies, but it's looking like the only life that needs saving now is yours.
prof_desc_male\u0004You used to rule the: You used to rule the roads before they were filled with wrecks, undead, and unspeakable horrors.  At least there's no speed limits in the apocalypse!
prof_desc_male\u0004You were a junior cr: You were a junior crewmember on a freight spaceship.  Without any exceptionally valuable abilities, you spent your workshifts performing miscellaneous maintenance tasks within the ship.  As such, you are moderately skilled at performing all sorts of minor electrical and mechanical repairs, a skillset you hope remains useful planetside…
prof_desc_male\u0004You are a well exper: You are a well experienced mercenary espatier, a soldier rated for both orbital and planetary combat.  Until the crash, you were part of a minor mercenary outfit that provided on-board and landing-site security for freight corporations, although it seems that your last contractor required more protection than what you could provide.  Unfortunately, most of your more specialized gear was left behind in your hasty evacuation…
prof_desc_male\u0004A sudden power failu: A sudden power failure woke you from the cryosleep sarcophagus in which you had entombed yourself lifetimes ago.  It seems the emergency reanimation procedure has damaged your memory, and now, bearing almost no knowledge of your past life, you must find a way to survive in a ruined and alien world.
prof_desc_male\u0004When the Cataclysm c: When the Cataclysm came, you were getting into your gear, prepared for the first manned entrance through a stabilized portal in the lab - just a quick five-minute scouting trip.  You were the last one left in the room when the portal snapped shut and all hell broke loose.  Now that you know what was on the other end, maybe that was a mercy.
prof_desc_male\u0004Grown in some corpor: Grown in some corporate laboratory to provide the perfect bodyguard, with nothing to live for but your client.  The Cataclysm ignored social strata and somehow you outlived your master.  Now no one knows the conditioning words to force your obedience.  While the world burns, you get your first taste of life.
prof_desc_male\u0004You worked as a tech: You worked as a technician in a sterile, high-security facility concerned with the fabrication of bionic implants.  The final evacuation order caught you in the middle of your 16 hour extended shift, and you barely managed to escape the building, tools in hand.
prof_desc_male\u0004Through a lifetime o: Through a lifetime of hard work, dedication, boot-licking and immense luck, you achieved the almost impossible, and were promoted from an indentured clerk to a minor managerial position.  Although you were still an expendable peon among the ranks of the corporation, you earned numbers most people could only dream of, and you savored it.
prof_desc_male\u0004You are an uplifted: You are an uplifted elephant hybrid, a precisely engineered enforcer creature created by combining human, elephant and mastodon DNA.  Unlike most of your war-minded kin, you sought a peaceful retirement after completing your compulsive service period, and even earned the right to be considered a full citizen.  Now, with the end of the world in the horizon, it seems that your combat skills might come useful once again.
prof_desc_male\u0004You worked as a merc: You worked as a mercenary across six continents for a dozen corps.  A VP at the last corp decided he wanted to put you on retainer and you agreed to a three month gig in return for some additional bionics.  You woke up with an extra bionic, a cranial bomb that needed to be reset every month or so or it blows up.  Now you have days until the bomb goes off.  Maybe you'll find someone who can remove it.  Can you even sleep, for fear of death?
prof_desc_male\u0004Created with the exp: Created with the exploration of the deep sea in mind, Cecaelia are hybridized from cephalopod and fish DNA.  While you were mostly spared from the corporate wars by your scientific proclivities, the polite niceties of the surface are mostly forgotten underwater.  You were on dry land when the Cataclysm occurred and you have no idea if it's safer here or beneath the seas.
prof_desc_male\u0004A combat-ready cybor: A combat-ready cyborg once salvaged from an obscure junkyard…
prof_desc_male\u0004You found a pamphlet: You found a pamphlet with bright colors claiming you can be a Wizard, oddly serene with the world falling down around you.
prof_desc_male\u0004You have loved fire: You have loved fire all of your life.  You have now discovered your inner fire, and want to exercise that upon the world.
prof_desc_male\u0004The ancient circle o: The ancient circle of druids is gone with the Cataclysm.  Nature must thrive.
prof_desc_male\u0004You always had to hi: You always had to hide your magic, as it was generally not an acceptable type of magic in the wizarding world, but with the Cataclysm you need to pull every trick out of the book.
prof_desc_male\u0004The son of a weather: The son of a weatherman, you were always interested in the weather.  Recently you found it was possible to manipulate the weather yourself through arcane means!  Unfortunately you did not have long to enjoy your power, as events unfolded…
prof_desc_male\u0004With the recent Cata: With the recent Cataclysm, the way you found to cheat on tests may have to find some other use.
prof_desc_male\u0004You segregated yours: You segregated yourself from society because you wanted to concentrate on improving yourself.  It was you and your best friend, but now the apocalypse won't leave you alone.
prof_desc_male\u0004You lost your faith: You lost your faith when your spouse died of illness.  You've been drinking yourself to death ever since.  God is punishing everyone with this apocalypse, you are going to show them your brand of mercy.
prof_desc_male\u0004You've long suspecte: You've long suspected the world might suddenly turn over.  With your training, spells, and revolver, your chances are far better than most.
prof_desc_male\u0004You've long had an o: You've long had an obsession with horror novels, and used your wealth to augment yourself with spells and bionics into a denizen of the night.  Your neglect to your health in your pursuit has left you pale and unlively.
prof_desc_male\u0004Your metal career so: Your metal career soared to new heights when you swapped special effects for acrid gore and spiked whips.  It seems the Cataclysm is now your final tour.
prof_desc_male\u0004You've made a name f: You've made a name for yourself in underground magic boxing rings as an unstoppable punching machine.  Now that all your opponents are undead, there's no need to hold back.
prof_desc_male\u0004After failing out of: After failing out of medical school, you took their mundane methods and combined it with magic to save your patients.  Now that they all want to kill you, the lack of a license is the least of your worries.
prof_desc_male\u0004Abandoned at a young: Abandoned at a young age and raised by moose, you had to master the wilds to survive.  While the modern world has been devoured, you and your steed are no stranger to hardship.
prof_desc_male\u0004You were a special o: You were a special operative conducting covert sniper ops in sub-zero temperatures, and had just finished your tour when society was destroyed.  Having retained your gear, it's time to join the new war.
prof_desc_male\u0004Penned in a cell wit: Penned in a cell without fuel, you've been extinguished for years for setting buildings on fire.  In your escape, you grabbed your familiar tool to reignite the embers.
prof_desc_male\u0004These bastards were: These bastards were destroying Earth far before the undead came, and mauling those execs was worth the federal charges.  Now, you may have greater priorities than pollution.
prof_desc_male\u0004You learned Kelvinis: You learned Kelvinist spells to keep equipment costs down on your ice cream truck.  While their tastes have changed, the kids still scream for you.
prof_desc_male\u0004You entertained the: You entertained the masses, displaying an expert hand tossing knives conjured from nowhere.  Now, you're bringing the show to them.
prof_desc_male\u0004You're a human shape: You're a human shaped candy brought to life under unknown circumstances.  You have your whole life ahead of you and it's gonna be sweet!
prof_desc_male\u0004You'll never get you: You'll never get your shot at the Cyberolympics.  All that's left of your dream is a single leftover protein shake.  Well, that and your bulging, cybernetically-enhanced muscles.
prof_desc_male\u0004Mortally injured in: Mortally injured in the line of duty, you were resurrected by the surgeons from the department's revolutionary Cybercop program.  Now, in these lawless times, you are truly the future of law enforcement.
prof_desc_male\u0004You always had to ha: You always had to have the latest and best gadgets and gizmos, so is it any wonder that you upgraded your flesh along with your smart phone?
prof_desc_male\u0004As a second-generati: As a second-generation augmented firefighter, you have been cybernetically enhanced to operate in the most dire of emergency situations.  You're pretty sure this counts.
prof_desc_male\u0004You came into a larg: You came into a large fortune, through luck or will, and hosted games for world-famous celebrities.  You could afford to spoil your players, and so you did.  You invested in bionics to make you smarter and memorized the entire handbook.  Let's hope that knowledge helps you now.
prof_desc_male\u0004You were the boss's: You were the boss's favorite, their protege; they always counted on you to get the toughest jobs done.  They invested in "basic" augments and the best gear on the market in preparation for your biggest hit yet.  Sadly, you came out of surgery to find your whole gang had been eaten.
prof_desc_male\u0004The product of milli: The product of millions of dollars of clandestine research, you are a bionic sleeper agent capable of silently engaging your target while maintaining an innocuous appearance.  Your handler cut all contact a week ago.
prof_desc_male\u0004When bionics first e: When bionics first emerged, you were quick to make them into your career, and spent your days overseeing their installation.  That makes you one of the few non-zombies in the world that can calibrate an Autodoc, which might come in handy.
prof_desc_male\u0004As one of the top su: As one of the top surgeons in the country, you were chosen for an augmentation program to expand the medical field.  With your expertise and augmentations, you can perform precise surgery with little assistance.
prof_desc_male\u0004You were employed by: You were employed by a major international corporation as a representative and technical advisor, utilizing the incredible power of your cybernetically augmented mind.
prof_desc_male\u0004When the diagnosis c: When the diagnosis came back positive, you signed up for a series of experimental bionic surgeries that saved your life.  Now you're healthier than you ever were before, thanks to a suite of bionic systems powered by your own metabolic functions.  Make the most of your second chance at life.
prof_desc_male\u0004You knew the end was: You knew the end was coming.  You augmented yourself with some basic bionic tools and underwent extensive survival training.  Now the end has come, and it is time to see if your efforts have paid off.
prof_desc_male\u0004You were the kind of: You were the kind of sportsman who couldn't get off the track.  You love running, and you enhanced your body with cybernetics to go even faster.  Now there's plenty to run from - this is your kind of game.
prof_desc_male\u0004A top-secret militar: A top-secret military program sought to convert you into the perfect sniper.  Your bionics, equipment, and extensive field training enable you to drop targets from implausible distances, even after weeks of total isolation in enemy territory.
prof_desc_male\u0004You are the result o: You are the result of one of the military's last research programs: a prototype cyborg soldier.  The wars they expected you to fight have become obsolete, but war never changes.
prof_desc_male\u0004Your body conceals s: Your body conceals several bionic components, worth millions of dollars in public taxes.  The government turned you into an infiltration and recon specialist: you have night vision, an alarm, lock picking capabilities and a hacking module.
prof_desc_male\u0004Your parents were so: Your parents were so obsessed with making sure you aced every test that they had you outfitted with bionics to enhance your intellect and memory.  Now you're facing the hardest test yet, and you're not sure if those are the right kind of tools for the job.
prof_desc_male\u0004Impeccable style and: Impeccable style and a few bionic tricks up your sleeve have seen you pull off a string of daring, high-profile heists.  The cops would love to get their hands on you, but seem otherwise occupied.
prof_desc_male\u0004For better or for wo: For better or for worse, bionic augmentation has turned you into a walking power tool.  Upgraded with a standard industrial-grade manual labor surgery and training package, you are augmented with bionic muscles and an integrated toolset, both powered by standard batteries.
prof_desc_male\u0004You were normal once: You were normal once.  Before the tests, before the procedures, before they stripped away every outward sign of your humanity.  You're more machine than human now, but that might prove to be an advantage against the horrors that await.
prof_desc_male\u0004Long ago your lifelo: Long ago your lifelong infatuation with bionic enhancement lead you into a shady world of back-alley bionic clinics and self-installed secondhand CBMs.  Your posthuman hunger still cries out to be fed; where will you get your bionic fix now?
prof_desc_male\u0004Completely overtaken: Completely overtaken by bionic-induced psychosis, you are a deformed posthuman monster, forced to hide in the shadows.  Amidst the desolation, however, even a creature such as yourself might find its niche.
prof_desc_male\u0004After a series of su: After a series of surgical mistakes, your body is a wreck of bionic parts.  You have a large capacity for power, but are filled with broken and useless bionics.  Your ethanol power supply still works, at least.
prof_desc_male\u0004Through a series of: Through a series of painful and expensive surgeries, you became a walking bionic weapon, your services as a mercenary available to the highest bidder.
prof_desc_female\u0004The last thing you: The last thing you remember was meeting God behind the local Foodplace.  Then people started eating each other.  This doesn't feel like a fever dream.
prof_desc_female\u0004You've practiced p: You've practiced parkour for many years, and made the world your playground.  It wouldn't be a lie to say that running is your life.  Which is good, because now that the end has come, you're running for your life.
prof_desc_female\u0004You have received: You have received some martial arts training at a local dojo.  You start with your choice of Karate, Judo, Aikido, Tai Chi, Taekwondo, or Pankration.
prof_desc_female\u0004You have studied t: You have studied the arts of the Shaolin monks.  You start with one of the five animal fighting styles: Tiger, Crane, Leopard, Snake, or Dragon.
prof_desc_female\u0004You are skilled in: You are skilled in maneuvering on skates.  You suffer lower penalties to dodging and are less likely to fall down if hit in melee combat while you're wearing rollerskates or rollerblades.
prof_desc_female\u0004Circumstance left: Circumstance left you wandering the world, alone.  Now there is nothing to go back to, even if you wanted to.  Perhaps your experience in fending for yourself will prove useful in this new world.
prof_desc_female\u0004Some would say tha: Some would say that there's nothing particularly notable about you, but you've survived, and that's more than most could say right now.
prof_desc_female\u0004At the start of th: At the start of the Cataclysm, you hunkered down in a bomb shelter with your collection of guns.  You've spent the past months eating canned food and practicing your aim.  Now it is winter - time to face the world above.
prof_desc_female\u0004Tailoring may not: Tailoring may not seem like the most useful skill when the world has ended.  Most people wouldn't expect a simple tailor to live very long.  This is your opportunity to prove them wrong.
prof_desc_female\u0004Bork bork! Years: Bork bork!  Years in the kitchen have left you carrying a prodigious bulk, but you managed to escape the carnage with your trusty butcher knife and only a small collection of stains on your uniform.
prof_desc_female\u0004What the deuyl? Y: What the deuyl?  Ye ne wist noo thing of this straunge plaas nor what wycked enchauntment brought ye hidder.  Wyth this accoustrement ye must needs underfongen to find newe lyflode in the most hidous Cataclysm man hath witnessed sithen that deluge Noe rood out in his greet schippe.
prof_desc_female\u0004Thanks to years of: Thanks to years of study and hard work in the lab, you're familiar with the basics of scientific inquiry.  Only one question remains: can you undo the very Cataclysm your colleagues helped create?
prof_desc_female\u0004Your flexible outl: Your flexible outlook on the law, the scuffles you've been in (and avoided) at the bar, and your impressive ability to weasel your way out of the consequences of your actions - all these skills have helped ensure your survival.  How much longer will they hold out?
prof_desc_female\u0004You used to be a p: You used to be a professional apiarist, building and maintaining beehives.  You had to abandon your precious bees when the Cataclysm struck, but at least you managed to grab some utensils and honey.
prof_desc_female\u0004You are the true F: You are the true Foodperson.  Some might think Foodperson is just a mascot, but you know better.  The mask has become your face, you are real, and the only thing standing between this world and oblivion is you.
prof_desc_female\u0004Joining the milita: Joining the military has been your dream for years.  You finally got in, just in time for your training to get interrupted by some sort of national emergency.  As far as you can tell, military command abandoned you in this hellhole when you missed the emergency evac.
prof_desc_female\u0004You were the best: You were the best of the best, the military's finest.  That's why you're still alive, even after all your comrades fell to the undead.  As far as you can tell, military command abandoned you in this hellhole when you missed the emergency evac.
prof_desc_female\u0004You were hired to: You were hired to take care of the housekeeping for a wealthy family.  Naturally, when things got bad, they all took off on a family vacation to somewhere unknown, leaving you to your fate.
prof_desc_female\u0004You were following: You were following a road at night, trying to get away from the horrors of the city, when you heard a voice calling out in the dark.  You followed, hoping they were friendly, but suddenly felt a searing pain in your head and blacked out.  You just woke up in this strange place… are you even on Earth anymore?
prof_desc_female\u0004You were ready. Y: You were ready.  You went in determined to find and rescue your friends.  Now the atmosphere in these twisting corridors grows heavy, and you don't feel quite so confident anymore.  You might be the one in need of a rescue soon.
prof_desc_female\u0004Fresh out of med s: Fresh out of med school, you've got little in the way of practical experience and just a handful of first-aid supplies.  You just hope it will be enough if 'physician, heal thyself' turns out to be more literal than you expected.
prof_desc_female\u0004The boss always sa: The boss always said he could rely on you to pull through on the tough jobs.  Shame he got himself smoked.  No problem; the world's always got a place for someone with your kind of talents.
prof_desc_female\u0004You had a boring,: You had a boring, underpaid job watching cameras and patrolling hallways, but things have suddenly gotten a lot more dangerous.  You have some useful equipment, but you've never had any call to use it until now.
prof_desc_female\u0004You used to mow la: You used to mow lawns and trim hedges for the wealthy.  Contract work was getting scarce even before the zombies came, but now you've got nothing left except your tools and expertise.
prof_desc_female\u0004You went on provid: You went on providing in-home care for the elderly even as the whole world fell apart around you.  You can only pray that you don't see your former clients among the walking dead…
prof_desc_female\u0004Living off the lan: Living off the land, far from civilization, is nothing new to you.  The only difference is all the monsters that suddenly want you dead.  Your equipment is basic, but versatile… except that your canteen's run out!
prof_desc_female\u0004You spent your car: You spent your career busting drug smugglers with your faithful canine companion.  Now the world has ended, and none of that matters anymore.  Your loyal dog is still at your side, though, ready to face the Cataclysm with you.
prof_desc_female\u0004Everyone is dead?: Everyone is dead?  Oh well, it doesn't matter; it's not like you got along with people much anyway.  Your beloved cats are all the friends you need!
prof_desc_female\u0004Just a small-town: Just a small-town deputy, you got the call and were ready to come to the rescue.  Soon it was you who needed rescuing, and you were lucky to escape with your life.  Who's going to respect your authority when the government this badge represents might not even exist anymore?
prof_desc_female\u0004You were on the br: You were on the brink of a major breakthrough in your latest homicide case when the Cataclysm struck.  Now your prime suspect is dead.  Everyone's dead.  You could really use a smoke.
prof_desc_female\u0004As a member of the: As a member of the police force's most elite division, you are more than adequately trained and equipped to survive the brutal onslaught of the apocalypse.  Unfortunately, the chain of command has broken down; your only mission now is to stay alive.

As a member of the police force's most elite division, you were given special training and became an expert in close-quarters combat.  Unfortunately, the chain of command has broken down; your only mission now is to stay alive.
prof_desc_female\u0004They said you'd se: They said you'd sell your own mother for a dollar.  How dare they!  You've been around the block a few times, and you'd charge way more than a dollar - and get it, too!
prof_desc_female\u0004Ever since you wer: Ever since you were a child you loved hunting, and quickly developed a talent for archery.  Why, if the world ended, there's nothing you'd want at your side more than your trusty bow.  So, when it did, you made sure to bring it along.

Ever since you were a child you loved hunting, and one year you got a shotgun for your birthday.  Why, if the world ended, there's nothing you'd want at your side more than your trusty shotgun.  So, when it did, you made sure to bring it along.

Ever since you were a child you loved hunting, and you fancy yourself a crack shot.  Why, if the world ended, there's nothing you'd want at your side more than your trusty rifle.  So, when it did, you made sure to bring it along.
prof_desc_female\u0004You used to work a: You used to work at a local hardware store, and you did plenty of home renovations yourself.  Now you look out at the horizon of a ruined world, and wonder - are your meager skills, and the few supplies you grabbed on the way out, sufficient to help rebuild?
prof_desc_female\u0004You once ruled the: You once ruled the road in your big rig.  When the riots hit, you hopped in and drove it to safety.  Now it's just you and your truck against the world.
prof_desc_female\u0004Small businesses o: Small businesses often hired you for electrical work.  You were halfway through your latest job when the whole power grid went dead.
prof_desc_female\u0004For the past few y: For the past few years you've been traveling the world, sightseeing and living off your parents' trust fund.  You came home to find the world in ruins, and the only thing between you and death is the open road and your backpack.
prof_desc_female\u0004You just stepped o: You just stepped out of a nice, hot shower to find the world had ended.  You've got some soap, along with the most massively useful thing ever… a towel.
prof_desc_female\u0004Things got a littl: Things got a little weird on your way to your weekly dance class.  Zombies don't seem to know how to dance, but you're not about to let them step on your toes.
prof_desc_female\u0004When the diagnosis: When the diagnosis came back positive, you made a vow: to fight for your life, and to never give in to despair.  Now is the time to renew that vow.
prof_desc_female\u0004You were a human g: You were a human guinea pig, used by laboratory technicians to understand the immense power of mutation.  You are determined to live on, if only to spite them for what they did to you.
prof_desc_female\u0004Your house has bee: Your house has been demolished and your planet destroyed, but at least you still have your towel.
prof_desc_female\u0004You spent most of: You spent most of your life trapping with your father.  Both of you made a decent living selling your catches and running trapping tutorials.  Hopefully, your skills will come in useful against less conventional game.
prof_desc_female\u0004You ran into troub: You ran into trouble coming out of class at your community college's metalsmithing program, but despite the havoc you've managed to keep ahold of some of the equipment you were carrying.
prof_desc_female\u0004All you ever wante: All you ever wanted was to make people laugh.  Dropping out of school and performing at kids' parties was a dream come true until the world ended.  There are precious few balloon animals in your future now.
prof_desc_female\u0004In the rush to saf: In the rush to safety, you were separated from your master by cruel fate.  Now you are on your own, with nothing to your name but a suit of really kinky black leather.  Unfortunately, there are no safewords in the apocalypse.
prof_desc_female\u0004You haven't seen t: You haven't seen this much blood since the war.  The whole world's gone crazy!  They ate your grandkids!  But dagnabbit, you'll make them all pay for what they've done.
prof_desc_female\u0004The Cataclysm stru: The Cataclysm struck on the big day and you escaped with nothing but your wedding attire.  Cold feet?  You'd just like to keep your feet attached!
prof_desc_female\u0004All those wicked s: All those wicked songs about the apocalypse have come to life.  Brutal!  Now that the system is dead, it's time to party among the bones of the world!
prof_desc_female\u0004Your ska band brok: Your ska band broke up after the drummer became a zombie.  Now you're alone in the Cataclysm with some cigarettes and your mp3 player.
prof_desc_female\u0004You were a serial: You were a serial killer, ready to walk the green mile, but in a twist of fate you're one of the few still alive.  True death comes only from your hands, so you're in for a job.
prof_desc_female\u0004You had a genius p: You had a genius plan to skim fractions of cents out of your company's accounts.  This plan immediately failed and got you arrested.  They said you were too soft for prison, but guess what?  They're dead, and you're not.
prof_desc_female\u0004You did your best: You did your best to expose what was going on in those labs, but they caught you and threw you in prison on trumped-up charges to silence you.  Clearly, they should have listened.
prof_desc_female\u0004You probably neede: You probably needed psychiatric help instead of a prison sentence.  At least your loyal subjects have agreed to hold the line as you make your daring escape.
prof_desc_female\u0004This could be your: This could be your lucky break.  Plenty of loot to be pilfered, and no cops to be seen.  Does it count as breaking and entering if everyone in town is undead?
prof_desc_female\u0004The jury were in t: The jury were in the palm of your hand, but after the defendant tried to eat your brain, you were forced to flee the courtroom in disgrace.  Now nobody seems to care about your objections.
prof_desc_female\u0004You were one of th: You were one of the maintainers of a Shinto shrine, performing rituals and sacred tasks.  You preferred it when only the spirits of the dead inhabited your shrine, and not their rotting corpses.
prof_desc_female\u0004Your life was simp: Your life was simple at the Vihara, doing household chores and meditating.  Your Sangha wanted to attain liberation from suffering, now their rotting corpses will suffer forever.
prof_desc_female\u0004You spent much of: You spent much of your time prior to the apocalypse at the local mosque, studying the words of the Prophet and the Quran and guiding your community in prayer.  Back then they came from far and wide to listen to you; now they come to eat your brains.
prof_desc_female\u0004You devoted your l: You devoted your life to spreading the good word, always on the road, traveling from town to town.  Now everything has gone to hell, you can't host your daily podcast, and the undead don't seem particularly moved by your sermons.
prof_desc_female\u0004You've decided tod: You've decided today is the day to take your first lesson at the local dojo.  You'll be great at it, you're sure of it.
prof_desc_female\u0004'Drop the martial: 'Drop the martial arts!', they said.  'Learn a skill for the REAL world!', they said.  Well, you're about to show them!  SHOW THEM ALL!
prof_desc_female\u0004As the world ends,: As the world ends, you alone stand against the coming darkness with your fists of steel.
prof_desc_female\u0004Following a clue f: Following a clue from your dead grandfather's journal, you made your way to a long-lost temple, but then the ground started to shake uncontrollably.  You had a bad feeling about that, so you got out of there quickly.
prof_desc_female\u0004You set out this m: You set out this morning to deliver the news of the apocalypse.  The undead hordes don't seem to value the latest news, but at least your trusty bicycle is still in working order.
prof_desc_female\u0004A patch of soil, s: A patch of soil, some water, and sunlight were all you ever needed; why should things be any different now?  With a handful of seeds and your trusty hoe, it's time to rebuild the Earth, one plant at a time.
prof_desc_female\u0004One of the lucky f: One of the lucky few who escaped the Cataclysm, you made a life for yourself amidst the ruins of civilization.  Whether through force, guile, or luck, you've obtained the best gear you could find.
prof_desc_female\u0004Over long years of: Over long years of self-imposed exile in the wilderness, you have come to an understanding with Mother Nature.  The world as they knew it might have ended for your forsaken species, but you can hardly tell the difference.
prof_desc_female\u0004You spent most of: You spent most of your days fishing in the swamp, getting by quietly on your catch.  You found the buzzing of insects enjoyable, but recently they've gotten bigger and meaner.  Now their horrible noises have you spooked - you just hope the fish aren't as nasty.
prof_desc_female\u0004You were on your w: You were on your way to the Annual All New England Revolutionary War Living History exhibition when the end of the world made traditional gender roles obsolete.
You were on your way to the Annual All New England Revolutionary War Living History exhibition when the end of the world permanently derailed your plans.
prof_desc_female\u0004You love to skate!: You love to skate!  You've probably spent more time on a pair of blades than off.  Things have gotten pretty bad, but at least the grown-ups aren't telling you where you can't roll.
prof_desc_female\u0004You never cared fo: You never cared for grown-ups telling you what to do, so you ended up spending quite a few days in the principal's office.  Now, not needing grown-ups to tell you what to do is the only reason you're alive.  Man, you really should've played hooky today.
prof_desc_female\u0004Your parents were: Your parents were crazy preppers who thought some "Cataclysm" was coming, and insisted on preparing you for it.  Turns out they were right.  You didn't get a chance to thank them.  The only thing you can do for them now is what they always hoped you would do in the dark days ahead: survive.
prof_desc_female\u0004In dodgeball, fail: In dodgeball, failing to dodge meant taking a ball to the head and being out of the game.  In the Cataclysm, it means getting eaten by monsters.  Don't slip up.
prof_desc_female\u0004The school never l: The school never let your club play with the really fun chemicals, the kind that make things go boom, but there aren't any teachers around to enforce the rules anymore.
prof_desc_female\u0004You were a member: You were a member of the school A/V club.  You're sure there's some way you can use your technical skills to help you stay alive.  You just haven't figured out how to make an awesome death ray yet.
prof_desc_female\u0004You've been teachi: You've been teaching kids all your life, experiencing the joy and aggravation of imparting knowledge to young minds.  If zombies have any interest in education, they're not showing it.
prof_desc_female\u0004Covering the apoca: Covering the apocalypse up close could make your career, though finding a publisher seems more difficult a prospect than usual.  You managed to hold onto your camera - hopefully you can get some fantastic shots.
prof_desc_female\u0004It was hard enough: It was hard enough getting kids to run laps without having to worry about them trying to eat your brains.  Zombies won't even line up when you blow your whistle.
prof_desc_female\u0004You're a miner, no: You're a miner, not a minor!  Your canteen is dry, your jackhammer is out of gas, and you're on your last pair of batteries for your mining helmet…
prof_desc_female\u0004Before this all be: Before this all began, you were having the time of your life at your dream job: blowing stuff up.  The Cataclysm means you're finally allowed to do it full time.
prof_desc_female\u0004You were called in: You were called in on your day off to feed the animals at the zoo.  For some reason, none of your coworkers bothered showing up for work today.
prof_desc_female\u0004Years of training: Years of training prepared you for the competitive fencing circuit, but your latest tournament was cut short when zombies invaded the piste.  The referee was eaten, so you're not sure if the rules are still in play.
prof_desc_female\u0004You've spent your: You've spent your life appealing to the people, persuading many and promising much throughout your time in office.  Now that your voting base wants to eat you alive, winning hearts and minds just got that much harder.
prof_desc_female\u0004Taking care of cow: Taking care of cows, horses, and other animals is your passion, but the ways things are going, this isn't going to be just another day at the ranch.
prof_desc_female\u0004You've always work: You've always worked just outside of the limelight, carrying and fixing the equipment and ensuring that the performers got what they needed.  The show must go on.
prof_desc_female\u0004You nailed your so: You nailed your solo, but the audience erupted into screams instead of applause.  You weren't able to grab much during the panic, but at least you have your loaded six string on your back.
prof_desc_female\u0004You made your livi: You made your living on Wild West exhibitions and shows, impressing tourists with your displays of marksmanship.  But that world has ended, so you took your trusty six-shooter and wandered into a world where it's always high noon.
prof_desc_female\u0004You were living th: You were living the high life, spending your parents' money without a care in the world.  At one of your usual crazy parties, the guests became hungry for more than drugs and booze, but you still have a chance to use the last symbol of your luxurious life - your sports car - and get far away.
prof_desc_female\u0004You got to see thi: You got to see things fall apart from the sky, transporting soldiers and survivors from one holdout to the next.  You knew it was only a matter of time before the horrors patrolling the skies shot you down.
prof_desc_female\u0004You were respondin: You were responding to a call with your partner before you got separated.  Now all you have is your trusty ambulance, ready to transport patients through the apocalypse.
prof_desc_female\u0004You were separated: You were separated from your partner while out on a call.  You managed to hang onto some medical supplies, but it's looking like the only life that needs saving now is yours.
prof_desc_female\u0004You used to rule t: You used to rule the roads before they were filled with wrecks, undead, and unspeakable horrors.  At least there's no speed limits in the apocalypse!
prof_desc_female\u0004You were a junior: You were a junior crewmember on a freight spaceship.  Without any exceptionally valuable abilities, you spent your workshifts performing miscellaneous maintenance tasks within the ship.  As such, you are moderately skilled at performing all sorts of minor electrical and mechanical repairs, a skillset you hope remains useful planetside…
prof_desc_female\u0004You are a well exp: You are a well experienced mercenary espatier, a soldier rated for both orbital and planetary combat.  Until the crash, you were part of a minor mercenary outfit that provided on-board and landing-site security for freight corporations, although it seems that your last contractor required more protection than what you could provide.  Unfortunately, most of your more specialized gear was left behind in your hasty evacuation…
prof_desc_female\u0004A sudden power fai: A sudden power failure woke you from the cryosleep sarcophagus in which you had entombed yourself lifetimes ago.  It seems the emergency reanimation procedure has damaged your memory, and now, bearing almost no knowledge of your past life, you must find a way to survive in a ruined and alien world.
prof_desc_female\u0004When the Cataclysm: When the Cataclysm came, you were getting into your gear, prepared for the first manned entrance through a stabilized portal in the lab - just a quick five-minute scouting trip.  You were the last one left in the room when the portal snapped shut and all hell broke loose.  Now that you know what was on the other end, maybe that was a mercy.
prof_desc_female\u0004Grown in some corp: Grown in some corporate laboratory to provide the perfect bodyguard, with nothing to live for but your client.  The Cataclysm ignored social strata and somehow you outlived your master.  Now no one knows the conditioning words to force your obedience.  While the world burns, you get your first taste of life.
prof_desc_female\u0004You worked as a te: You worked as a technician in a sterile, high-security facility concerned with the fabrication of bionic implants.  The final evacuation order caught you in the middle of your 16 hour extended shift, and you barely managed to escape the building, tools in hand.
prof_desc_female\u0004Through a lifetime: Through a lifetime of hard work, dedication, boot-licking and immense luck, you achieved the almost impossible, and were promoted from an indentured clerk to a minor managerial position.  Although you were still an expendable peon among the ranks of the corporation, you earned numbers most people could only dream of, and you savored it.
prof_desc_female\u0004You are an uplifte: You are an uplifted elephant hybrid, a precisely engineered enforcer creature created by combining human, elephant and mastodon DNA.  Unlike most of your war-minded kin, you sought a peaceful retirement after completing your compulsive service period, and even earned the right to be considered a full citizen.  Now, with the end of the world in the horizon, it seems that your combat skills might come useful once again.
prof_desc_female\u0004You worked as a me: You worked as a mercenary across six continents for a dozen corps.  A VP at the last corp decided he wanted to put you on retainer and you agreed to a three month gig in return for some additional bionics.  You woke up with an extra bionic, a cranial bomb that needed to be reset every month or so or it blows up.  Now you have days until the bomb goes off.  Maybe you'll find someone who can remove it.  Can you even sleep, for fear of death?
prof_desc_female\u0004Created with the e: Created with the exploration of the deep sea in mind, Cecaelia are hybridized from cephalopod and fish DNA.  While you were mostly spared from the corporate wars by your scientific proclivities, the polite niceties of the surface are mostly forgotten underwater.  You were on dry land when the Cataclysm occurred and you have no idea if it's safer here or beneath the seas.
prof_desc_female\u0004A combat-ready cyb: A combat-ready cyborg once salvaged from an obscure junkyard…
prof_desc_female\u0004You found a pamphl: You found a pamphlet with bright colors claiming you can be a Wizard, oddly serene with the world falling down around you.
prof_desc_female\u0004You have loved fir: You have loved fire all of your life.  You have now discovered your inner fire, and want to exercise that upon the world.
prof_desc_female\u0004The ancient circle: The ancient circle of druids is gone with the Cataclysm.  Nature must thrive.
prof_desc_female\u0004You always had to: You always had to hide your magic, as it was generally not an acceptable type of magic in the wizarding world, but with the Cataclysm you need to pull every trick out of the book.
prof_desc_female\u0004The son of a weath: The son of a weatherman, you were always interested in the weather.  Recently you found it was possible to manipulate the weather yourself through arcane means!  Unfortunately you did not have long to enjoy your power, as events unfolded…
prof_desc_female\u0004With the recent Ca: With the recent Cataclysm, the way you found to cheat on tests may have to find some other use.
prof_desc_female\u0004You segregated you: You segregated yourself from society because you wanted to concentrate on improving yourself.  It was you and your best friend, but now the apocalypse won't leave you alone.
prof_desc_female\u0004You lost your fait: You lost your faith when your spouse died of illness.  You've been drinking yourself to death ever since.  God is punishing everyone with this apocalypse, you are going to show them your brand of mercy.
prof_desc_female\u0004You've long suspec: You've long suspected the world might suddenly turn over.  With your training, spells, and revolver, your chances are far better than most.
prof_desc_female\u0004You've long had an: You've long had an obsession with horror novels, and used your wealth to augment yourself with spells and bionics into a denizen of the night.  Your neglect to your health in your pursuit has left you pale and unlively.
prof_desc_female\u0004Your metal career: Your metal career soared to new heights when you swapped special effects for acrid gore and spiked whips.  It seems the Cataclysm is now your final tour.
prof_desc_female\u0004You've made a name: You've made a name for yourself in underground magic boxing rings as an unstoppable punching machine.  Now that all your opponents are undead, there's no need to hold back.
prof_desc_female\u0004After failing out: After failing out of medical school, you took their mundane methods and combined it with magic to save your patients.  Now that they all want to kill you, the lack of a license is the least of your worries.
prof_desc_female\u0004Abandoned at a you: Abandoned at a young age and raised by moose, you had to master the wilds to survive.  While the modern world has been devoured, you and your steed are no stranger to hardship.
prof_desc_female\u0004You were a special: You were a special operative conducting covert sniper ops in sub-zero temperatures, and had just finished your tour when society was destroyed.  Having retained your gear, it's time to join the new war.
prof_desc_female\u0004Penned in a cell w: Penned in a cell without fuel, you've been extinguished for years for setting buildings on fire.  In your escape, you grabbed your familiar tool to reignite the embers.
prof_desc_female\u0004These bastards wer: These bastards were destroying Earth far before the undead came, and mauling those execs was worth the federal charges.  Now, you may have greater priorities than pollution.
prof_desc_female\u0004You learned Kelvin: You learned Kelvinist spells to keep equipment costs down on your ice cream truck.  While their tastes have changed, the kids still scream for you.
prof_desc_female\u0004You entertained th: You entertained the masses, displaying an expert hand tossing knives conjured from nowhere.  Now, you're bringing the show to them.
prof_desc_female\u0004You're a human sha: You're a human shaped candy brought to life under unknown circumstances.  You have your whole life ahead of you and it's gonna be sweet!
prof_desc_female\u0004You'll never get y: You'll never get your shot at the Cyberolympics.  All that's left of your dream is a single leftover protein shake.  Well, that and your bulging, cybernetically-enhanced muscles.
prof_desc_female\u0004Mortally injured i: Mortally injured in the line of duty, you were resurrected by the surgeons from the department's revolutionary Cybercop program.  Now, in these lawless times, you are truly the future of law enforcement.
prof_desc_female\u0004You always had to: You always had to have the latest and best gadgets and gizmos, so is it any wonder that you upgraded your flesh along with your smart phone?
prof_desc_female\u0004As a second-genera: As a second-generation augmented firefighter, you have been cybernetically enhanced to operate in the most dire of emergency situations.  You're pretty sure this counts.
prof_desc_female\u0004You came into a la: You came into a large fortune, through luck or will, and hosted games for world-famous celebrities.  You could afford to spoil your players, and so you did.  You invested in bionics to make you smarter and memorized the entire handbook.  Let's hope that knowledge helps you now.
prof_desc_female\u0004You were the boss': You were the boss's favorite, their protege; they always counted on you to get the toughest jobs done.  They invested in "basic" augments and the best gear on the market in preparation for your biggest hit yet.  Sadly, you came out of surgery to find your whole gang had been eaten.
prof_desc_female\u0004The product of mil: The product of millions of dollars of clandestine research, you are a bionic sleeper agent capable of silently engaging your target while maintaining an innocuous appearance.  Your handler cut all contact a week ago.
prof_desc_female\u0004When bionics first: When bionics first emerged, you were quick to make them into your career, and spent your days overseeing their installation.  That makes you one of the few non-zombies in the world that can calibrate an Autodoc, which might come in handy.
prof_desc_female\u0004As one of the top: As one of the top surgeons in the country, you were chosen for an augmentation program to expand the medical field.  With your expertise and augmentations, you can perform precise surgery with little assistance.
prof_desc_female\u0004You were employed: You were employed by a major international corporation as a representative and technical advisor, utilizing the incredible power of your cybernetically augmented mind.
prof_desc_female\u0004When the diagnosis: When the diagnosis came back positive, you signed up for a series of experimental bionic surgeries that saved your life.  Now you're healthier than you ever were before, thanks to a suite of bionic systems powered by your own metabolic functions.  Make the most of your second chance at life.
prof_desc_female\u0004You knew the end w: You knew the end was coming.  You augmented yourself with some basic bionic tools and underwent extensive survival training.  Now the end has come, and it is time to see if your efforts have paid off.
prof_desc_female\u0004You were the kind: You were the kind of sportsman who couldn't get off the track.  You love running, and you enhanced your body with cybernetics to go even faster.  Now there's plenty to run from - this is your kind of game.
prof_desc_female\u0004A top-secret milit: A top-secret military program sought to convert you into the perfect sniper.  Your bionics, equipment, and extensive field training enable you to drop targets from implausible distances, even after weeks of total isolation in enemy territory.
prof_desc_female\u0004You are the result: You are the result of one of the military's last research programs: a prototype cyborg soldier.  The wars they expected you to fight have become obsolete, but war never changes.
prof_desc_female\u0004Your body conceals: Your body conceals several bionic components, worth millions of dollars in public taxes.  The government turned you into an infiltration and recon specialist: you have night vision, an alarm, lock picking capabilities and a hacking module.
prof_desc_female\u0004Your parents were: Your parents were so obsessed with making sure you aced every test that they had you outfitted with bionics to enhance your intellect and memory.  Now you're facing the hardest test yet, and you're not sure if those are the right kind of tools for the job.
prof_desc_female\u0004Impeccable style a: Impeccable style and a few bionic tricks up your sleeve have seen you pull off a string of daring, high-profile heists.  The cops would love to get their hands on you, but seem otherwise occupied.
prof_desc_female\u0004For better or for: For better or for worse, bionic augmentation has turned you into a walking power tool.  Upgraded with a standard industrial-grade manual labor surgery and training package, you are augmented with bionic muscles and an integrated toolset, both powered by standard batteries.
prof_desc_female\u0004You were normal on: You were normal once.  Before the tests, before the procedures, before they stripped away every outward sign of your humanity.  You're more machine than human now, but that might prove to be an advantage against the horrors that await.
prof_desc_female\u0004Long ago your life: Long ago your lifelong infatuation with bionic enhancement lead you into a shady world of back-alley bionic clinics and self-installed secondhand CBMs.  Your posthuman hunger still cries out to be fed; where will you get your bionic fix now?
prof_desc_female\u0004Completely overtak: Completely overtaken by bionic-induced psychosis, you are a deformed posthuman monster, forced to hide in the shadows.  Amidst the desolation, however, even a creature such as yourself might find its niche.
prof_desc_female\u0004After a series of: After a series of surgical mistakes, your body is a wreck of bionic parts.  You have a large capacity for power, but are filled with broken and useless bionics.  Your ethanol power supply still works, at least.
prof_desc_female\u0004Through a series o: Through a series of painful and expensive surgeries, you became a walking bionic weapon, your services as a mercenary available to the highest bidder.
scen_desc_male\u0004You have survived th: You have survived the initial wave of panic, and have achieved (relative) safety in one of the many government evac shelters.

You have survived the initial wave of panic, and have achieved (relative) safety in an abandoned building.  Unfortunately, while you're the only one here now, you are definitely not the first person to be here, and in its current state this building no longer seems nearly as secure as one might have hoped.
scen_desc_male\u0004You feel spores craw: You feel spores crawling beneath your skin.  It's only a matter of time.
scen_desc_male\u0004The building you had: The building you had chosen to reside in has suddenly caught fire!  You might want to leave.
scen_desc_male\u0004You start drunk to t: You start drunk to the point of incapacitation, depressed, infected, surrounded by fire, and sick with the flu.  This day went downhill really fast.
scen_desc_male\u0004Som nigromancie hath: Som nigromancie hath brought yow hidder!  Ye have only the hoose on youre legges and the knyf at youre syde and youre prayeres to Marie moder of God.
scen_desc_male\u0004The scientists stopp: The scientists stopped their experiments on you abruptly, leaving you behind while they evacuated before lockdown.  Find a way to escape or starve to death.
scen_desc_male\u0004A little over a year: A little over a year has passed since the apocalypse started, and you're about to face your second summer in Hell.
scen_desc_male\u0004You were participati: You were participating in a mining operation when you found… something.  You're not sure what, but it sure is dark down here.
scen_desc_male\u0004During the riots and: During the riots and chaos, you hid in a robot dispatch center hoping the robots would protect you, but they may prove more dangerous than the zombies.
scen_desc_male\u0004You've been preachin: You've been preaching your faith for a long time, but the recent events have begun to make you doubt it.  Wandering in your temple, you just found books that may restore your faith or shatter it completely.
scen_desc_male\u0004You have been an app: You have been an apprentice to a wizard for some time now, working on a prototype device that could perhaps be used to escape from the Cataclysm.  Something went wrong with the maiden voyage though, and your teacher teleported his insides into his outsides.  Now you have to figure out how to survive on your own.  At least he left his notebook…

You have been an apprentice to a wizard for some time now, you've saved for years for your dream vacation at a secluded wizard tower.  Your journey of self-discovery is interrupted by the Cataclysm.  Now you have to figure out how to survive on your own.
scen_desc_male\u0004You are an exile, wh: You are an exile, whether because of people shunning you because of who you are or from a personal choice.  The dead aren't willing to leave you be.
scen_desc_male\u0004What was to be a rou: What was to be a routine cargo transfer ended in tragedy when, in a brief moment of chaos, your space ship was intercepted and destroyed by a StO missile.  As soon as the MAW alarm flared to life, you scrambled to the nearest escape pod and barely managed reach the uncertain safety of the planet below.
scen_desc_male\u0004In the chaos and pan: In the chaos and panic of evacuation, you got bitten by something!  You didn't get proper medical care, and now the wound has started turning green.
scen_desc_male\u0004It is the winter aft: It is the winter after zero hour.  As you were scavenging for food and a warm place to stay at, you heard the sound of lots of movement nearby.
scen_desc_male\u0004You find yourself am: You find yourself amongst trees.  The screaming and the moaning is fainter this far from civilization, but you'd better know what you're doing out here.
scen_desc_male\u0004Before the world end: Before the world ended, bionics were reserved for the rich and the famous.  You might not have been either, but you wanted in.  Hidden offices sequestered away in basements, anesthetic smuggled out of hospitals, and desperate people with little to lose could get you what you wanted.  If you went too deep, however, your augmentation may have come at a price…

npc:f\u0004STOP, Put your hands in the a: STOP, Put your hands in the air!  Ha, startled you didn't I… there is no law anymore…
npc:f\u0004I was watching the station wh: I was watching the station when things went sideways.  None of the other officers returned from the last call, well not as humans anyway…
npc:f\u0004This is a nice, secure buildi: This is a nice, secure building.  I'd be a fool to leave.  Been living off the vending machines, but I found the code for the evidence lockup so I've been doing some trading with other survivors.
npc:f\u0004I… I'm free. *Zzzt* I'm actu: I… I'm free.  *Zzzt* I'm actually free!  *bzzz* Look, you're the first person I've seen in a long time.
npc:f\u0004I'm a priest or guide of a so: I'm a priest or guide of a sort.  I sing the hymns along my companions so that we may learn to live in unity, both with each other and with our ailing world.
npc:f\u0004I heard it's bad in the citie: I heard it's bad in the cities, back when the radio was still working.  Some of those things came through here.  I want to stay out in the country if I can stay safe.
npc:f\u0004I'm a lot better now, I've be: I'm a lot better now, I've been hunkering down here.  Something came by in the night screaming and crying, sounded just like that woman.  Maybe a ghost, I don't know.  It's good to have company again.  You're not a ghost, right?  On second thought, don't tell me if you are, I probably don't want to know.
