u:n\u0004You're back. Have you come to: You're back.  Have you come to listen to the song?
u:n\u0004I see. And you live still. Do: I see.  And you live still.  Does that mean you managed to stop him?
u:n\u0004It saddens me to see a talented: It saddens me to see a talented Kindred lose his way so greatly, but I take solace in the fact that you are unscathed.
u:n\u0004And how many people have you ki: And how many people have you killed?  Maybe it was in self defense, maybe because you wanted their gear.  It's all the same.  I give their death meaning.  I hate that I have to do it, I truly do, but you really must understand, there is no other way.  The sooner I finish my mission, the sooner all this madness can end.
You're like me then, Kindred.  I'm glad I'm not the only one who realizes what's necessary.  Perhaps one day, we'll be able to work together, but what I do now, I must do alone.
u:n\u0004You're Kindred, and yet you que: You're Kindred, and yet you question the power the bones hold, the Song itself?  This hypocrisy is why I set off on my own.  Stop wasting my time and get out of my way.
u:n\u0004You asked me recently; ask agai: You asked me recently; ask again later.
u:n\u0004You just asked me for stuff; as: You just asked me for stuff; ask later.
u:n\u0004Are you sure? This doesn't see: Are you sure?  This doesn't seem like a particularly safe place for small talk…
u:n\u0004Hello traveler, what brings you: Hello traveler, what brings you here?
u:n\u0004Hey, who the fuck are you? I h:
Hey, who the fuck are you?  I haven't seen you 'round.  Ah, fuck it, it doesn't matter.
Here's the rules.  The first and most important one: ALWAYS CLOSE THE FUCKING ENTRY DOOR BEHIND YOUR ASS!  If you're okay with that, the following rules are: don't fuck with us, don't steal from us, don't start a fight without a reason with someone from us.  Got it, punk?  Now get lost.
u:n\u0004How are you here? Are you one: How are you here?  Are you one of them, somehow?  What's going on?
u:n\u0004I'm sorry to say it after all y: I'm sorry to say it after all you've done for me, but… I don't suppose you've got anything to eat?
u:n\u0004Well… you have shown that you c: Well… you have shown that you can survive out there, and you've been able to provide food, so I know you're thriving more than we are here.  All right, I'll tell you what.  I'm not going anywhere without my friends here, we've been through way too much together.  If you can convince Luo, Brandon, and Yusuke to come along, then I'll go.
u:n\u0004Yeah, I'm real hungry and they: Yeah, I'm real hungry and they put drugs in most of the food.  I can see you're not like that.
u:n\u0004Look, I'm sorry for freaking ou: Look, I'm sorry for freaking out earlier.  You might be an asshole but I'm sure you didn't mean it like that.  My blood sugar is hella low, I get a bit cranky.  We cool?
u:n\u0004Hey there, not-asshole. Good t: Hey there, not-asshole.  Good to see you again.
u:n\u0004Oooooh. Oh. You did not just: Oooooh.  Oh.  You did not just fucking go there.  Let's leave the fatties to die, hey?  Wanna know how easy it is to find fucking *thyroid medication* after the apocalypse, asshat?  Besides, there are more skills than heavy lifting needed now… no, you know what?  Screw it.  You're not worth my time.
u:n\u0004Thanks again for the grub, my f: Thanks again for the grub, my friend.
u:n\u0004Oh, wow! You're a real gem, yo: Oh, wow!  You're a real gem, you know that?  Thanks for even thinking of it.
u:n\u0004Well… I'll be honest, I didn't: Well… I'll be honest, I didn't even think Dave could be sorted out, and you've gone and called my bluff!  It's a darn fine thing you've done for that poor soul.  Listen, I wasn't… entirely serious about wanting to come with you, but if you can convince the others to go, then I guess I'll come along.
u:n\u0004Well now, that's quite a kind o: Well now, that's quite a kind offer, and I appreciate you looking past my full-body pubic hair.  Sorry though.  I've come to feel sort of responsible for this little gaggle of squatters.  As long as I'm the only one providing for them, I don't think I can leave.
u:n\u0004You're back, and still alive!: You're back, and still alive!  Whoa.
u:n\u0004Yo, you're crazy hot! I'm not: Yo, you're crazy hot!  I'm not stupid!
u:n\u0004Well, well. I'm glad you are b: Well, well.  I'm glad you are back.
u:n\u0004Yes, my friend. You have done: Yes, my friend.  You have done so much for me, I would be glad to teach you what I can.  I must ask a small amount in trade, for materials.  I hope you understand.
u:n\u0004Have you had a problem with mem: Have you had a problem with memory, friend?  I was the one who asked you this, I thought I explained why I could not.
u:n\u0004Have you heard anything back fr: Have you heard anything back from the ranch about jobs yet?
Always good to see you, friend.
u:n\u0004My savior! My patron of the ar: My savior!  My patron of the arts!  You're always welcome here, friend.
u:n\u0004Where you say you're from again: Where you say you're from again?  You're not as worldly as you look.  I'm talking about weed.  Marijuana.  Wondered if you've happened upon any.
u:n\u0004Sold! Thanks for helping me ou: Sold!  Thanks for helping me out, friend.
u:n\u0004Sure, I could teach you the bas: Sure, I could teach you the basics, it'll cost you merch though.  Since you helped me out, I can shave a bit off the price, let's say 4 merch, plus a bit in trade depending on how in-depth you're looking for?
u:n\u0004Things are coming along. I hav: Things are coming along.  I have a lot of studying to do before I know how to fix my design issues, but the book you brought definitely has everything I need.  Now that I've got some progress to show, administration is much more willing to help me get the parts I need.  You've been a great gofer, but I can probably handle the rest on my own.  Check back in a week or two!
u:n\u0004You're new here, who the hell p: You're new here, who the hell put you up to this crap?
u:n\u0004As if you're one to talk. Scre: As if you're one to talk.  Screw You.
u:n\u0004Have you ever noticed how… wait: Have you ever noticed how… wait no, never mind.
